worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.summary: Brace and lean into one extending straight thrust. Each enemy along the line receives one combined strike; walls stop the tip, and the original exhaustion follows retraction.
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.descript: The original per-segment base is about %1$s, combining %2$s segments into one contact strike. Each target is settled once per use.
The thrust extends to %1$s blocks with tip half-width %2$s, advancing another segment every %3$s. Its direction is fixed at commitment.
After retraction, exhaustion lasts %1$s, preventing new actions, normal attacks and movement.
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.use.0: A rapid flurry of heavy close swings
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.use.1: Sweep several foes packed in front at once
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.use.2: Trade the longest exhaustion for the highest burst
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.preferen: More segments combine into greater strike power, but extend the thrust and exhaustion. Fewer segments retract sooner.
Below this health fraction the user stops starting Meteor Assaults (unless the target is nearly down). Higher avoids being dazed and punished.
Prefer angles containing several enemies in one narrow line; disable to focus on single-target value.
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.timing: Quick wind-up, medium recovery; sweeps are evenly spaced and the daze settles after the last one.
worldcombat.skill.meteorassault.growth.0: From level 40 each swing gains another step with level.
